findings.summary: a failed held-tree lookup is never retried and drops the duty
findings.text: reckon/crew/obligations.py:3844: _rows_naming_trees swallows every exception and returns no rows, but the caller records the new tree in index.inspected at line 4556 regardless, so a transient store failure permanently drops that tree's held duty; the new_trees set is computed as inspected - index.inspected and will not offer the tree again, and the docstring's promise that it 'joins the held set on the next fresh build' waits on an unrelated aggregate rewrite. Retrying a lookup that failed, or not recording the inspected set on failure, would keep a held tree from silently disappearing from the duty view.

justifications.durability: tests/test_fleet_state_reuses_its_reads_between_ticks.py:342-382 fails if 4c4bf5a45c regresses and tests/test_held_worktrees_are_read_once_per_change.py:186 fails if the new_trees path regresses; both are red at base and green at head.
justifications.evidence: the head importer arm's failure ids are a subset of the base arm's (44 vs 63, zero head-only), so added_failure_count is 0, and the two negative-control cases appear as base-only FAILED ids in gates/base-importer-01-all_debug.log.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/obligations.py:3824 follows the module's private-helper idiom with a mechanism docstring and adds no plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/obligations.py:4556-4573 files a tree registered after the last read by asking the store only for that tree's rows, which is the repair the goal states: a tree registered after a sweep has no row filed against it otherwise.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/obligations.py:3839 calls the existing open_run_index.rows_naming_trees owner, reckon/file_memo.py:373 extends the module that owns the read-only region, and reckon/run_store.py:1309 stays the module that owns the answer cache.
justifications.scope_discipline: the gained diff's five paths are exactly the five the goal names, and no path outside them changed.

verdicts.diff: read commit by commit over a1d432530d..f69887117f: f5bd2cba91 replaces the per-file stat walk with obligations/_directory_identity and adds the plan cache; d6dc8c6041 and 4c4bf5a45c fix the held-tree index; the remaining five commits change only the evidence fragment's quoted gate figures.
verdicts.done_when: the node's done_when names tests/test_an_unchanged_sweep_reads_no_plan_and_walks_no_tree.py; the head fence log at revision 6ede4dd00a records 75 passed and the base fence log at a1d432530d records 2 failed 69 passed, each with revision, literal command and a closing EXIT= line.
verdicts.goal: the commits gained since the prior review repair the held-worktree index the sweep feeds: reckon/crew/obligations.py:3824 adds _rows_naming_trees and :4427 _held_worktree_records_read files every aggregate row and every newly registered tree's row, and :1323 run_store and :373 file_memo stop copying rows inside a read-only region.
verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, eight commits, the fence and importer gate logs, and artifacts reconciling the arms, but it carries no baseline_suite or after_suite JSON block, so the added-failure figures had to be derived from gates/{base,head}-importer-0*-all_debug.log and the fence pair rather than read off the manifest.
verdicts.write_paths: the gained diff touches only docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once-s120.html, reckon/crew/obligations.py, reckon/file_memo.py, reckon/run_store.py and tests/test_held_worktrees_are_read_once_per_change.py, all inside the node's declared write paths.
